summary.zh: 网页搜索、抓取与结构化提取
summary.en: Web search, scraping, and structured extraction

description.zh:
搜索网页、抓取页面内容并提取结构化数据。
也可检索论文并抓取多页面站点；公开访问，可选填 Firecrawl API Key。
description.en:
Search the web, scrape page content, and extract structured data.
Also supports paper search and multi-page crawling; public access with an optional Firecrawl API key.

authHint.zh: 公开访问；可选填 Firecrawl API Key。
authHint.en: Public access; Firecrawl API key optional.
